customer_reply: Thank you for reaching out. The bulk‑approve button is intentionally disabled when the number of selected purchase orders exceeds the system’s bulk‑approval limit. You can work around this by approving the orders in smaller batches. For details, please see KB‑4859 – Bulk approval limits (by design). If you need a higher limit for your organization, let us know and we can discuss a custom solution.
internal_note: Identified by design limit via KB-4859. Not a bug. Feature request with workaround.
